non_blocking_issues: [server #7 (5b), major, code] A worker can be lost permanently: _spawn(block=False) gives up after RESPAWN_ATTEMPTS=5 (~3 s of backoff) and nothing ever calls _spawn again; with DF_WORKERS=1 every later request waits its full budget and is answered 1 ('saturated') until restart, even after forking works again (demonstrated by patching _ctx.Process to raise EAGAIN: live 0, then [1,'saturated'] at 1.001 s twice). Trigger needs fork or warm-up to fail five times in ~3 s (EAGAIN/ENOMEM near the 1 GiB limit), so unlikely, but unrecoverable. Line 111's 'Respawn retries with backoff' is true but incomplete. Recommend a follow-up: retry a spawn on the classify path whenever live < n_workers and none is in flight; until then document the bound and that /model shows respawn_failed > 0, live < workers.
